name: d_imgui
description: cimgui docking-branch D shim for vibe3d (imgui 1.92.8)
preBuildCommands-linux: cd "$PACKAGE_DIR" && git submodule sync --quiet extern/cimgui && git submodule update --init --recursive --quiet extern/cimgui
preBuildCommands-osx: cd "$PACKAGE_DIR" && git submodule sync --quiet extern/cimgui && git submodule update --init --recursive --quiet extern/cimgui
preBuildCommands-windows: cd /d "$PACKAGE_DIR" && bash -lc "git submodule sync --quiet extern/cimgui && git submodule update --init --recursive --quiet extern/cimgui"
